notes: Quiz answer notes show their question (Q1, Q3) at both ends of their line, on screen and in exported files. With the pointer on a note, its line and its question light up.

Quiz boxes has Answer lines start: right of each box, under it, or by the mark. Each question has a gold pin you can drag to move its line on every paper, and on one paper you can drag a note’s pill with any tool but the eraser.
